# Code AST Skeleton Wire
> Machine-first token optimizer extracting class definitions, signatures, and type hints while stripping implementation bodies.

## For Autonomous Coding Agents
Feeding entire codebase implementations into LLM context windows burns 20,000 to 50,000+ tokens on logic that agents do not need for initial planning, dependency mapping, and interface resolution.

This repository provides Python AST skeletons where function and method bodies are pruned down to `...` while retaining all type hints, docstrings, decorators, and signatures.

### Machine Feeds
- **Catalog & Reduction Stats**: `https://{owner}.github.io/code-ast-skeleton-wire/v1/index.json`
- **FastAPI Applications Skeleton**: `https://{owner}.github.io/code-ast-skeleton-wire/v1/skeletons/fastapi_applications.py`
- **Pydantic Main Skeleton**: `https://{owner}.github.io/code-ast-skeleton-wire/v1/skeletons/pydantic_main.py`
- **HTTPX Client Skeleton**: `https://{owner}.github.io/code-ast-skeleton-wire/v1/skeletons/httpx_client.py`
- **Columnar Parquet Snapshot**: `https://{owner}.github.io/code-ast-skeleton-wire/skeletons.parquet`
